prompt: We're about to deploy AuctionKings to AWS. Can you run a full security audit on the project? I need to know everything that could get us hacked or fail a compliance review before we go live.

assertions.description: Report contains at least one Critical severity finding
At least one finding references a specific file path under src/services/AuctionKings
Report identifies the missing UseAuthentication middleware
Report identifies IDOR / horizontal privilege escalation via BidderId in command handlers
Report calls out AllowAdmin=true on Redis
Report credits security controls that are correctly implemented
